constraints.message: Bus is priced per bus per month. A duration in months is required.
constraints.source: 336 of 337 bus price options carry a Month unit

constraints.message: Full Wrap and Full Bus Branding are distinct panel specifications and are not offered in every city. Do not sell All 3 Sides as full body.
constraints.source: Media Type attribute: Full Wrap 30, Full Bus Branding 41, All 3 Sides 5. Lucknow has no full wrap option.
constraints.fix: Report infeasible under exact_only and list the panel specs the city does offer.

constraints.message: Two bus options in the same city with the same panel spec and size differ by more than 3x. Do not choose on price until the desk confirms the rates are real.
constraints.source: Lucknow: Marco Polo 15000, Solus Mazda 4200, Tata Marco Polo 1800, all 100 sqft All 3 Sides

constraints.message: State-level networks such as UPSRTC run across the state, not within one city. They satisfy a state brief but not a city-only brief.

scenarios.message: Brief says city only but the product is a state network. Exclude and flag, even when include_state_networks is true.

do: Show Display Charges, Printing and Installation, and Charges Per Bus Per Month as three separate columns.
Name the bus type, it is what distinguishes the rate.
